newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti not altering valuation of stakes.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti not altering valuation of stakes.

text.p: Italian information technology group Olivetti said in a statement it would not modify the criteria by which it valued its shareholdings in subsidiaries.

Olivetti supplying answers to 16 questions on the state of its finances posed by Italian stock market watchdog Consob, said it did not consider altering the evaluation criteria, given that the book value, which takes into account depreciation, was on the whole lower than the relative value expressed by the market.
Consob had asked the company to explain the rationale behind the valuation of some Olivetti subsidiaries at June 30, 1996.
